title: Kelip
description: A ton of random but useful changes and items
body:
Kelip Is a small little mod that adds random yet useful items, like a burning coal axe that makes any wood cut into charcoal (feature still in dev)

Current items:
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Copper Armor set | No Special effects
- Copper Tool set | No Special effects
- Burning coal | Used to craft the Burning coal axe
- Burning Coal Axe | (not yet impemented) Turns any wood cut, into charcoal

</details>
